translations.text: "For John the Baptist baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit now, after a few days.
The whole company was a hundred and twenty people, continuing with one mind in prayer."
The Saviour taught the holy doctrine to his disciples before his passion, and after his resurrection he remained among them for forty days,

from the holy Easter season until this present day. In many ways he rebuked and tested his disciples, and repeated what he had taught them before, so that they would have full teaching and right faith.
He ate after his resurrection, not because he needed earthly food any longer, but so that he would show that his body was real.
He ate through his power, not out of need. Just as fire consumes a drop of water, so Christ's divine power consumed the food he had eaten.
The holy company asked Christ whether he would bring this world to an end at that time. He said to them in answer, "It is not for you to know the time that my Father has set by his own power."

The apostles were witnesses of Christ's works, because they preached his passion, his resurrection and his ascension, first to the Jewish people. Afterwards their voice went out to every land, and their words to the ends of the whole world.
The two angels said that Christ will come in the same way as he went up, because at the great judgement he will be seen in human form, so that those who killed him can recognize him.
Holy Scripture says, "Tollatur impius ne uideat gloriam Dei": "Let the sight of God's glory be taken away from the wicked."
Those who believed quickly helped us less than those who doubted, because the doubters looked at and touched the scars of Christ's wounds, and so drove all doubts from our hearts.
Grass and trees live without feeling. They do not live through a soul, but through their greenness.
Again he said, "What good does it do you to have faith if you do not have good works?
The person who will not believe in God and has no fear of God is worse than the devil.
The person who believes and has fear, but still will not do good, is like the devils.

The person who believes rightly, lives his life rightly, and does good works in the fear of God until the end of his life will be saved, and he will have eternal life with God and with all his saints.
In the same way Almighty God showed his miracles to the heathen people for as long as it took them to become believers. Once the faith had spread throughout the whole world, the miracles ceased.
My brothers, do not love the miracles that can be shared by good and evil people alike. Love instead the signs that belong only to good people: the signs of true love and godliness.
These signs are hidden and free of danger, and the less glory they have among men, the greater the reward they have with God.
We read in the old law that two men of God, Enoch and Elijah, were raised up to heaven without death. But they are only delaying death and will not escape it entirely.

The first man, Enoch, was carried to the heaven of the air, and Elijah was lifted up in a chariot. But the Almighty Saviour was neither carried nor lifted. He passed through the heavens of the sky by his own power.
It is for us to consider how chastity was growing, through the servants who were carried away and through the ascending Saviour.
Enoch was carried away, who had been begotten through sexual union, and who himself begot children through sexual union.
The Saviour ascended to heaven, who was not begotten through sexual union, nor did he himself beget children;
Now the commentator says, "It is rightly said that he sat after his ascension, because a seat befits a judge."
The martyr saw him standing, because he was his helper in the suffering of his martyrdom, and through his grace he was emboldened against the fierce persecutors who cruelly stoned him.
John in Asia, Bartholomew in India, Matthew in Ethiopia, and so each of them in his own portion, and God's power was with them to carry out their preaching and countless miracles;
because Christ said, "You can do nothing without me." Again he said, "I am with you all days,
